_about: Single source of truth for the KNX Club Jordan digital identity. Values here mirror what the site actually ships (app/globals.css, app/[locale]/layout.tsx, lib/i18n.ts). If you change one, change the other.

legalDescriptor.en: A non-profit professional community for the KNX building and home automation standard in Jordan.
legalDescriptor.ar: مجتمع مهني غير ربحي لمعيار KNX لأتمتة المباني والمنازل الذكية في الأردن.

tagline.en: Smart buildings · open standard · one community
tagline.ar: مبانٍ ذكية · معيار مفتوح · مجتمع واحد

shortTagline.en: The professional KNX community of Jordan.

elevator.en: KNX Club Jordan is the professional community for engineers, integrators, architects, and specialists working with the world's leading open standard for home and building automation.
elevator.ar: نادي KNX الأردني هو المجتمع المهني للمهندسين والمكاملين والمعماريين والمختصين العاملين بالمعيار المفتوح الأول عالمياً لأتمتة المنازل والمباني.

principles: Professional, not promotional. State what the club does; skip superlatives.
Concrete over abstract. Name the standard, the tool (ETS6), the city, the date.
Arabic is the default voice, English the equal second — never a machine translation of the other.
Short sentences. One idea per line. The hero is three lines, not a paragraph.
Never claim vendor endorsement: the club follows the open KNX standard, it does not speak for KNX Association.

clearBand.note: fully transparent — the safe cut line for square lockups

squareLockup.rule: For any square format (favicon, app icon, avatar) do NOT letterbox the wide lockup. Split at the clear band and stack arc over wordmark.

logo.clearSpace: Keep free space equal to the height of the K on all four sides.

onDark.rule: The mark is green + mid-grey + a dark blue X; the blue sinks on near-black. Lift it, do not dim it.

misuse: Do not recolor, outline, or add a gradient to the mark.
Do not stretch, rotate, or skew it.
Do not place it on a busy photo without a white card behind it (see the OG image pattern).
Do not typeset 'KNX Club Jordan' in a different face and call it the logo.

color._note: Brand steps are fixed in both themes. Semantic tokens are re-pointed for dark by `html.dark` in app/globals.css — build on the semantic names, never the raw hex.

gradients.ambientLight: radial washes of rgba(0,176,112,.16) / rgba(0,122,77,.14) / rgba(167,243,208,.25) — see .knx-animated-bg

usage.60: canvas — white in light, green-tinted near-black (#0a0f0e) in dark
usage.30: ink and ink-muted for type, line for hairlines
usage.10: brand green, and only as accent: eyebrows, icons, badges, hover states
usage.rule: Green is the accent, never the background of a full page. The one high-contrast panel (Join) uses `invert`, not green.

color.contrast: Body text must clear WCAG AA 4.5:1 on its surface. `accent` (#007a4d) passes on white; the raw `knx` (#00965e) does not at small sizes — use accent for green text.

scale.eyebrow: text-xs, font-semibold, uppercase (Latin only), tracking-wide, color accent

rules: Never uppercase Arabic — it has no case and letterspacing breaks the joins.
Arabic eyebrows keep sentence case and normal tracking.
Numerals stay Western (38+, 2026) in both locales, matching lib/i18n.ts.
Body copy caps at max-w-3xl for readability.

layout.hairline: 1px solid var(--color-line) — the default separator; shadows are for floating UI only
layout.direction: Arabic is RTL and is the default locale (/ → /ar). Author with logical properties (inset-inline, ms/me, text-start) and Tailwind's rtl: variants — never left/right.

motion.themeSwap: circular View Transitions wipe driven from the pull cord; 0.4s fade fallback
motion.rule: Opacity and transform only. Every animation must be cancelled under prefers-reduced-motion.

signatures._note: The details that make an asset read as KNX Club Jordan rather than generic.
signatures.pullCord: The dark/light switch is a physical pull cord hanging from the header. It is the club's one piece of personality — keep it in product screenshots.
signatures.greenTintedDark: Dark mode is a green-tinted near-black (#0a0f0e), not pure black, so the green reads as part of the surface.
signatures.threeLineHero: Headlines break into three lines with the middle line in accent green: 'Smart buildings, / open standard, / one community.'
signatures.ambientWash: Three soft green radial washes behind key sections (.knx-animated-bg).

assets.openGraph: app/[locale]/opengraph-image.tsx — 1200×630, green gradient, logo on a white card, tagline in knx-100, footer in knx-200
